label: Adults
descriptiontext: People aged 16 years and over.

label: Decline label
descriptiontext: This label shows a measure’s trend has moved in a direction considered to be negative.

label: Final energy consumption
descriptiontext: Final energy consumption is the direct consumption of fuels compared to primary consumption that relates to the fuel input.

label: Gini coefficient
descriptiontext: A measure of the overall extent to which groupings of households, from the bottom of the income distribution upwards, receive less than an equal share of income. For example, the bottom 5% of households might only have a 1% share of total household income. The lower its value, the more equally household income is distributed.

label: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
descriptiontext: The total value of output in the economic territory. It is the balancing item on the production account for the whole economy. Domestic product can be measured as gross or net. It is presented in the accounts at market (or purchasers’) prices.

label: Healthy life expectancy
descriptiontext: Healthy life expectancy (HLE) is defined as the number of years an individual can expect to spend in very good or good general health. It can either be calculated as years from birth or years remaining from a fixed point.

label: Human capital
descriptiontext: The knowledge, skills and characteristics embodied in individuals that facilitate the creation of personal, social and economic well-being.

label: Improvement label
descriptiontext: This label shows a measure’s trend has moved in a direction considered to be positive.

label: Measure
descriptiontext: How we represent and track the things people told us matter to their well-being within each of the 10 domains.

label: Median household disposable income
descriptiontext: The median household income is the income of what would be the middle household, if all households in the UK were sorted in a list from poorest to richest. As it represents the middle of the income distribution, the median household income provides a good indication of the standard of living of the “typical” household in terms of income.

label: No change label
descriptiontext: This label shows there has been no statistically significant change in a measure over a set time. If a difference exists between the same periods in an accompanying chart, it is not considered statistically significant.

label: Change not assessed label
descriptiontext: This label shows that we have not assessed the direction a measure might have moved in. Please see our User guide for why change may not have been assessed.

label: Objective measures
descriptiontext: Focus on reporting facts about people’s lives and the spaces in which they live.

label: Pre-pandemic
descriptiontext: The period before Quarter 1 (January to March) 2020.

label: Public sector net debt
descriptiontext: Net debt, for the purposes of UK fiscal policy, is defined as total gross financial liabilities less liquid financial assets, where liquid assets are cash and short-term assets, which can be realised for cash at short notice and without significant loss. These liquid assets mainly comprise foreign exchange reserves and bank deposits. The net debt is a cash measure that is priced at nominal value (the cost to the issuer at redemption) and consolidated (intra-sector holdings of liabilities/assets are removed).

label: Seasonally adjusted
descriptiontext: The purpose of seasonal adjustment is to remove systematic calendar-related variation associated with the time of the year (seasonal effects). This facilitates comparisons between consecutive time periods.

label: Statistical significance
descriptiontext:
Measures have been assessed as having improved or declined if the difference between the comparison periods is statistically significant using non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals, where available. If a difference is said to be statistically significant, it is unlikely that it could have occurred by chance alone.
More information on statistical significance and confidence intervals is available.

label: Subjective measures
descriptiontext: Focus on directly asking people about their feelings, opinions and sentiments.

label: Territorial basis
descriptiontext: Territorial basis for greenhouse gas emissions refers to the accounting of greenhouse gases emitted within the geographic boundaries of the United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland).

label: Unpaid Work
descriptiontext: Unpaid work includes unpaid household work (for example, cooking and cleaning), DIY, gardening, unpaid childcare, unpaid adult care and volunteering.
